create_evalai_submission_oc20: create an evalAI submission file for OC20 dataset by joining id, ood_ads, ood_cat, and ood_both results
create_evalai_submission_oc22: create an evalAI submission file for OC22 dataset by joining id and ood results
write_is2re_predictions_from_trajectorie: write IS2RE predictions from .traj trajectory files using the --is2re-relaxations flag
write_is2re_hybrid_predictions: write IS2RE predictions from S2EF NPZ files using both --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid flags
run_make_submission_file_cli: run the make_submission_file CLI script with --id, --out-path, and --dataset arguments to generate a compressed NPZ submission
